# mcp/tests/fixtures/knowledge_files/4.5-decision-d12-local-family-routes.json

## Governing Overview

[mcp/tests overview](../../overview.md)

## Purpose

**Doc14 §4.5 decision record, encoded in MIK-R21's normative shape.** The file holds decision D12 as a record whose `governs`/`reconsider_on` became `links` (`constrains`, `reconsider_on` with its `alternative`, `motivated_change_to` to a requirement reference). It is
read by `test_doc14_worked_examples_validate_and_round_trip_byte_for_byte`, which requires it to
parse as `DecisionRecord` and to re-serialize to exactly these bytes.

## Code Commentary

### Logic

A canonical JSON document (`schema: ar-decision/v1`): sorted keys, two-space indentation, one trailing
newline — the output of `agents-remember knowledge-format` on itself.

### Conventions

Test data only; never imported by production code. Recorded `blob` values are the real blobs at base
`b7ef73f8`; `content` hashes are illustrative.

### Invariants And Boundaries

- The file must stay canonical: any hand edit must be followed by `agents-remember knowledge-format`
  or the round-trip case fails.
- The fixture set is closed: the test asserts the directory holds exactly the nine names it lists.
